title: monitoring.md's OpenTelemetry section names where a new kbmon panel's points go
goal: kb/_self/monitoring.md's Adding an OpenTelemetry signal section says a new panel is a mon_base.PANELS entry and a points function plus an EXPORTERS row in _tools/mon_export.py, not a mon_<name>.py points module

run: import sys;t=open('kb/_self/monitoring.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('## Adding an OpenTelemetry signal');j=t.find('\n## ',i+3);s=' '.join(t[i:j if j>0 else len(t)].split());miss=[p for p in ('PANELS','EXPORTERS','_tools/mon_export.py') if p not in s];bad='gets its points by `mon_<name>.py`' in s;print('missing',miss,'old wording',bad);sys.exit(1 if i<0 or miss or bad else 0)
